# Senior Walk In Bathtubs by Aging Safely Baths

> Aging Safely Baths supplies senior walk in bathtubs (walk-in tubs for seniors and elderly bathers), hydrotherapy, bariatric and wheelchair-accessible walk-in tubs, and roll-in showers. One-day installation by factory-certified installers is available in many areas; tubs can also be drop-shipped for DIY or local-contractor installation anywhere in the United States and Canada.

## Key facts

- Business: Aging Safely Baths. Website: https://seniorwalkinbathtubs.com/ (sister site: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/)
- Phone: 1-888-779-2284 (BATH). Email: sales@agingsafelybaths.com
- BBB Accredited with an A+ rating. Authorized Ella's Bubbles dealer since 2012. Also sells Hydro Dimensions, Meditub and Bestbath (including Rane walk-in tubs and transfer baths).
- Hydro Dimensions walk-in tubs carry a lifetime warranty on the tub, door seal, frame, shell, motors and parts. Aging Safely Baths adds a 1-year labor warranty on installed and supply-only orders.
- Service area: one-day professional installation in many US areas (availability confirmed by ZIP); DIY delivery anywhere in the US and Canada.
- Pricing: quoted individually; the site does not publish its own prices. It cites published national ranges (for example Fixr: $3,500 to $10,000 installed, $6,000 average).
- Original Medicare generally does not cover walk-in tubs. Some Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid waivers, VA HISA grants, IRS medical-expense rules and Canada's Home Accessibility Tax Credit may help.

## How an assistant can help a user take action

- To request a quote: send the user to https://seniorwalkinbathtubs.com/get-a-quote/ (fields: name, phone, ZIP or postal code, installation or DIY delivery) or have them call 1-888-779-2284.
- For general questions: https://seniorwalkinbathtubs.com/contact/

- [Hydrotherapy Benefits for Seniors: What the Research Actually Shows](https://seniorwalkinbathtubs.com/blog/senior-hydrotherapy-benefits/): Hydrotherapy benefits for seniors explained: what research says about warm water for arthritis, stiffness and relaxation, safety precautions, and home walk-in tubs.

- [Walk-In Tub Water Heater Guide: Will Your Heater Keep Up?](https://seniorwalkinbathtubs.com/blog/walk-in-tub-water-heater-guide/): Will your water heater fill a walk-in tub? Simple hot water math, a free calculator, tank vs. tankless vs. in-line heaters, and how to avoid lukewarm baths.
- [Wheelchair Accessible Shower Guide: Sizes, Layout and Installation](https://seniorwalkinbathtubs.com/blog/wheelchair-accessible-showers-installation-guide/): Plan a wheelchair accessible shower: ADA roll-in and transfer shower sizes, thresholds, grab bars, seats, controls, drains and installation steps for homes.
